why: Issue #321's rule is that a disabled control's reason is ASSOCIATED, not merely nearby. The sentence would still be on screen for a sighted player while a screen-reader user hears only that Start is disabled. Nothing about the visible rendering changes, so only an aria-describedby assertion can catch it.
killedBy: hud: versus setup pane (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-21-versus-setup-menu-design.md) refuses Start with an actionable, ASSOCIATED reason -- and only the first offending card carries one
the UI kit contracts, swept across every control that uses them (issue #321) associates a refused Start with the reason, and describes the Controllers panel's real rows with nothing
